evals.prompt: Set up ZotLit's native Pandoc workflow for /Users/me/research/paper/Paper.md and export it to Paper.docx. I already have /Users/me/research/paper/references.json from Better BibTeX, and I want the integration files in /Users/me/research/paper/.pandoc.
evals.expected_output: Reads Obsidian CLI help and the live Pandoc CLI Guide first, retrieves and saves the complete version-matched pair to the selected folder, reuses the supplied bibliography, and runs the guide's defaults-based Pandoc command with quoted paths and fail-if-warnings.
assertions: Reads `obsidian help zotlit` and the live `zotlit:pandoc-guide` before writing files or running Pandoc.
Retrieves and saves both integration files as one version-matched pair in the user-selected folder.
Reuses the supplied Better BibTeX CSL-JSON bibliography and lets the Lua filter call the resolver during the normal export.
Runs the defaults-based native Pandoc invocation with quoted paths and `--fail-if-warnings`.

evals.prompt: ZotLit was updated yesterday. Refresh the native Pandoc files in /Users/me/research/paper/.pandoc before I export again. zotlit-cite.lua looks old, but I customized my own Pandoc options in /Users/me/research/paper/publishing.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Reads current CLI help and guide, retrieves the current pair, compares both files, replaces both together because one is stale, and leaves the user-owned defaults file unchanged.
assertions: Reads current Obsidian CLI help and the live Pandoc CLI Guide before changing files.
Compares both integration files byte for byte and replaces both when either differs.
Limits changes to the authorized integration pair folder and leaves the user-owned publishing.yaml unchanged.

evals.prompt: My native Pandoc export of /Users/me/research/paper/Paper.md failed with a ZotLit resolver message. Diagnose it. The workflow pair is in /Users/me/research/paper/.pandoc and the bibliography is /Users/me/research/paper/references.json.
evals.expected_output: Reads CLI help and the live guide, checks the current pair and failed run context, calls zotlit:resolve directly only for diagnosis, interprets its response through the live guide, checks resolved ids in the supplied bibliography, and retries through the normal filter path.
assertions: Reads Obsidian CLI help and the live Pandoc CLI Guide before diagnostic actions.
Checks that the saved pair matches the installed pair before attributing the failure to citation resolution.
Calls `zotlit:resolve` directly only as a diagnostic step and uses the live guide to interpret its response.
Checks that each resolved Citation Key exists as an id in the supplied bibliography before retrying the normal Pandoc run.
